meta.parties: Ram Iswara v. Commissioner of Inland Revenue

rules.statement: The Supreme Court can examine whether the Board of Review applied relevant legal principles correctly in a case involving mixed law and fact, even if it involves an isolated transaction.
rules.supporting_quote: "Even an isolated transaction can satisfy the description of an adventure in the nature of trade. Each case must, however, be determined on the total impression created on the mind of the Court by all the relevant facts and circumstances."
